edition.regulation: Georgia Rules for Water Quality Control 391-3-6-.03

source_scope.designated_uses: Complete Savannah River Basin table, 30 named reach entries, section (14).
source_scope.trout_protection: Complete statewide county trout designation section (15)(b), 256 clauses in 31 counties; 18 None declarations retained separately.
source_scope.geographic_membership: The original 217-HUC study membership is determined by an explicit native geometry crosswalk. A basin or county label alone is not a measured intersection.

interpretation: Each designated use and trout clause remains a distinct legal record; overlapping designations are not added as separate stream length.
Class labels and complete reach descriptions are original. Display labels derived from trout paragraphs have automatic name matching disabled.
The edition approval date is not a per-reach adoption date; effective_date is null unless the original record supplies one.
Default Fishing is retained as a general rule. Missing or unassociated geometry is not automatically labeled Fishing.
The DNR public fishing map is simplified NHD-derived angling geography, without statutory Primary/Secondary fields; it is not automatically assigned these legal clauses.

policy_references.interpretation: General designated-use table and default Fishing rule.
Original Primary/Secondary trout definitions and additional criteria; definitions remain distinct from designated uses.

spans.waterbody_name: Savannah River/Lake Russell and Clarks Hill Lake
